widgets_values:
Welcome to JonXL's TIR2V Workflow (version v2.0)

https://civitai.com/models/2884206/minimax-h3-photorealistic-image-generator-lora-workflow

To start, choose "Text to Video", "Image to Video" or "Reference to Video" 

For Reference to Video, please change the Diffusion Model to a ref2va safetensors model.

----

Please configure the steps, resolutions, and frame duration yourself, disabling or enabling Turbo lora does not automaticaly change the step count.

Option 3.1 I2V | REF Scale Estimation can be enabled to try to match the highest resolution possible using the first loaded image aspect ratio and given width*height.
When disabled in Reference mode, it will output exactly the given width and height.
When disabled in Image mode, it will try to match the nearest resolution that is below the given width and height.
Tip: Look at the left of these notes to see the Ouput Width and Height.

Valid resolution sides:

240, 288, 320, 384, 480, 512, 576, 640, 768, 800, 832, 864, 896, 960, 1024, 1088, 1152, 1216, 1248, 1280, 1344, 1400, 1440, 1536, 1600, 1664, 1920, 2048, 2160, 2304, 2400, 2560, 2688, 2880, 3072, 3200, 3840

Valid frame counts according to the formula 17n+5 are:

5, 22, 39, 56, 73, 90, 107, 124, 141, 158, and 175

Note that 124 frames is 5 seconds.
